objective: Test perturbation responsiveness and direct component differences within frozen CRRM388; use clinical associations as a separate cross-context comparison

design.human: 12 independent experimental replicates, not 12 donors; unpaired 4 vs 4 intervention comparison. Baseline deposited as 0h; no uninfected drug arm. No intervention-by-infection interaction or restoration claim.
design.mouse: Frozen 84967-cell source, 11 lung source units (4 uninfected vehicle, 3 RSV vehicle, 4 RSV TMX/RelA CKO), day21; no uninfected TMX arm in these transcriptomes. Not an acute replication of the human drug contrast.
design.missing_mouse_sample: GSM8842521 / library225 is in GEO but absent from the frozen descriptor; retain existing resource subset without adding a fourth infected control.
design.human_columns: Order reconstruction AB1..4 baseline, AB5..8 RSV, AB9..12 RSV+ZL0454; retained as an explicit metadata assumption and corroborated against published marker patterns.

normalization.human: log2(1+author-deposited normalized abundance/TPM); never DESeq2 on this decimal matrix; all12 profiles form one study-specific gene mean/sample-SD reference.
normalization.mouse: native probe counts -> per-cell log1p(10000*host_counts/total_host_counts) -> mean per animal and canonical lineage; all11 prespecified complete lineages form one shared study reference with equal total weight per animal; population weighted SD, guard1e-8.
normalization.rank: Per-profile signed within-transcriptome average percentile rank; distinct score units; no gene-z/rank effect pooling.
normalization.eligibility: total >=70%388 and >=50% each original direction; branches >=5 and >=50% frozen members; primary mouse >=30 cells/profile and >=3 animals/group; thresholds15/50 are separate checks.

annotations: Seven original overlapping subsets and original 79/309 IFN-list partition; no new signature or outcome-selected members

correction_families.intervention_total: BH12 across human plus all11 eligible mouse lineages
correction_families.intervention_branches: BH84 across7 fixed branches x12 contrasts
correction_families.intervention_contributions: BH24 across2 signed contributions x12 contrasts
correction_families.infection_context: Separate corresponding BH12/BH84/BH24 families; human baseline time differs as deposited
correction_families.direct_component_comparisons: BH24 across (TNF/NFkB minus IFN-list overlap) and (degranulation annotation minus IFN-list overlap), in each of12 intervention contrasts; compare per-profile component differences, not separate significance labels
correction_families.clinical_gene_alignment: BH3 across the two frozen Severe-minus-Mild gene vectors and paired recovery-minus-acute vector; exact human treatment-label permutation of 8 profiles (70 allocations), retaining correlated genes as a vector; no gene-as-independent-replicate P values
correction_families.gene_tests: BH4656 for388 members x12 intervention contrasts, retaining unavailable tests in denominator
correction_families.sensitivities: Each method repeats its corresponding full prespecified family; no best-method selection or reduced displayed-row family

inference: Unpaired Welch t and pointwise95%t intervals at independent culture/source-animal level; exact whole-unit studentized permutation as corroboration; both-group near-constant signed values <=1e-12 yield P=1, never numerical significance
sensitivities: TNF/degranulation outside IFN lists: direct comparisons to IFN overlap
clinical_bridge: Fixed25-member annotation subset only; actual Result3 frozen severe/mild log expression effects; recovery effects reconstructed from the15 previously verified initially moderate/severe participant pairs. Correlation across gene-effect vectors evaluated by intervention-unit permutation. Not transportable clinical intervention efficacy.
interpretation: Possible broad suppression, selective attenuation, persistence or opposite shifts are all reportable. Outside IFN lists is annotation membership, not IFN independence; degranulation annotation is not measured degranulation activity. Mouse TMX contrast is the intervention-associated result under this design; nonrecombined lineage changes are not cell-autonomous proof.
